'''Mrs. Otter''' (Japanese: '''おタネ''' ''Otane'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG090|Pokéblock, Stock, and Berry]]''. Her name in the English [[dub]] was only revealed through the closed captions available on [[Prime Video]].

Mrs. Otter runs the store single-handedly and keeps her [[Pokéblock]] recipes secret, even from her daughter {{ho|Kelly}}. She sources her {{Berries}} from the freshest source, the Lilycove Berry Market. She stocks many varieties and also makes special order batches. Mrs. Otter also uses her store as a training school, as she went on to teach {{an|May}} how to make her own Pokéblocks using a [[Berry Blender]].
